feature: Rival probes, physical withdrawal, response intervals and larger committed invasions, with scouting and territory reports open at requested 4x.
note: Natural checkpoints are reached by full fixed ticks between live 4x renderer windows, not continuous real-time playback of the whole match. Observer may continue after player defeat, labeled in each row. Growth-cap and battle fixtures explicitly add workers through the real spawn path and food to isolate capacity; these are not naturally achieved populations. No aggregate ants or skipped off-screen updates.
